name: NASA Goddard High School Student Shadow Day
org: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, Office of STEM Engagement

offerings.summary: A one-day job-shadow at NASA Goddard where students follow a NASA subject-matter expert in one of twelve STEM fields.

grades.raw: This opportunity is open to High School students

citizenship.raw: United States citizens or Lawful Permanent Residents

school.raw: Students must be enrolled in a public, private, charter, or home school located in the state of Maryland or the District of Columbia.

sched.schedule_raw: 10 a.m. - 1 p.m. Eastern; arrival 9 - 9:45 a.m. for check-in

deadlines.raw: Registration Closes - April 18, 2025 or until all slots filled

issues: No 2026 or 2027 shadow day has been announced on this page; the 2025 cycle is retained as history and the page is a monitor target

sources.title: Goddard High School Student Shadow Program
